pr_title: Update project templates to replace DateTime with DateOnly
pr_body:
# Update project templates to replace DateTime with DateOnly
All instances of DateTime in project templates in regard to weather forecast have been replaced with DateOnly.

There is no DateOnly instance that is equivalent to DateTime.Now. The solution used to display the current date with DateOnly is linked [here](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/69798302/datetime-now-equivalent-for-timeonly-and-dateonly).

Fixes #38075

issue_context.title: Update project templates to use DateOnly instead of DateTime where appropriate
issue_context.body: All the weather forecast template code should probably use `DateOnly` instead of `DateTime`.
comments: Note that `System.Text.Json` doesn't support `DateOnly` yet AFAIK: dotnet/runtime#53539
